The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

title: Sr. Product Manager - B2C and Events
description:
**ABOUT US**

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**OUR PEOPLE**

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**OUR IMPACT**

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The B2C/Creators Product team at HighLevel is focused on building and scaling a world-class learning experience for our customers and their audiences. The platform currently serves over 1.1 million monthly active users, making it one of HighLevel's most widely adopted products. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at scale while solving B2C-style learner experience problems within a B2B2C product ecosystem.

Events is one of the newest products in HighLevel's Memberships suite, currently in beta and being built from the ground up. It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Organizers build and run their events from the Memberships admin; attendees live the whole thing inside Client Portal, next to the courses, communities and credentials they already sign in for.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap** Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.
* **Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It –** Know the category cold. Get the expected capabilities right — ticket tiers, promo codes, capacity and waitlists, recurring and series events, refunds, embeddable widgets, calendar sync, wallet passes — and then decide deliberately where we go further than the incumbents rather than matching them feature for feature.
* **Take Events from Beta to GA –** Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.
* **Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments –** Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.
* **Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience –** Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Turn attendee data ownership from a talking point into the product's most obvious advantage.
* **Own Event-Day Operations –** Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.
* **Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal –** Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.
* **Drive Distribution and Discovery –** Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.
* **Open the Platform –** Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.
* **Champion UI/UX Excellence –** Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.
* **Talk to Organizers Constantly –** Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.
* **Experiment and Optimize –** Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.
* **Support Scale, Reliability and Trust –** Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally –** Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.
* **Define and Own the Metrics –** Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.
* **Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features –** Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* **B2C Experience –** You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.
* **An End-to-End Owner –** You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.
* **UX-Attentive for Learning –** You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.
* **Experimentation-Minded –** You are comfortable running A/B tests and structured experiments to improve learner engagement and completion rates through rapid, evidence-based iteration.
* **Learner-Centric –** You consistently balance business objectives with learner success, keeping learner needs, motivation, and outcomes at the center of product decisions.
* **Customer-Obsessed –** You seek out organizers directly, run your own discovery, and can translate what you hear into product decisions without waiting for a research team to formalize it.
* **Strategic and Execution-Focused –** You can contribute meaningfully to product vision while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution to ensure ideas translate into real, measurable impact.
* **Data-Informed –** You rely on behavioral data, funnel metrics, and cohort analysis to prioritize initiatives, validate assumptions, and guide product decisions.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to events, ticketing, marketplace, commerce or B2B2C SaaS products.
* Proven track record of taking a product from early stage to scaled adoption, with clear ownership of the decisions that made it work.
* Hands-on experience with monetization mechanics — checkout, pricing and packaging, payments, refunds, payouts and fee structure — and the operational realities that come with them.
* Working knowledge of the events and ticketing category, including how platforms such as Eventbrite, Luma, Meetup and Cvent are positioned, priced and differentiated.
* Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, with the ability to partner closely with design to deliver intuitive, accessible and high-quality journeys for two distinct user types: organizers and attendees.
* Familiarity with SaaS and B2C platform growth levers, including user activation, engagement loops, retention, lifecycle optimization, and audience monetization.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
* Bonus: You have worked on an events, ticketing or community platform and can clearly articulate your personal impact on organizer growth, conversion and revenue.

**WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?**

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Description

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.

The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to simplifying and automating end-to-end business processes across the client lifecycle and making client interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of this team, you will play a pivotal role in transforming cross-functional Client Services processes through scalable products, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead high-impact digital, automation, and AI products that improve Client Services processes across the client lifecycle, including integrations between enterprise platforms and internal and external systems. This role will own product strategy, discovery, solution design, roadmap prioritization, and execution across a portfolio spanning multiple business domains and cross-functional teams, driving measurable client, employee, risk, and operational outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate is a senior product leader with exceptional execution skills, technical and AI fluency, and a record of solving complex enterprise challenges. They apply rigorous critical thinking, customer empathy, and user-centric design; make sound decisions with incomplete information; influence executive stakeholders; lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives; and translate ambitious visions into measurable outcomes. This role requires a leader who can operate effectively across business, product, design, technology, and operations teams while maintaining a relentless focus on user experience, business value, and delivery excellence. The successful candidate will help shape the future of our platforms by driving intelligent automation, AI-enabled experiences, and seamless integrations that improve productivity, scalability, and client outcomes, and will provide portfolio-level guidance and mentorship that elevates product management capability across the organization.

Responsibilities

* Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of digital, automation, AI, agentic, and integration capabilities that improve Client Services processes enterprise-wide across the full client lifecycle and multiple business domains, setting the strategic direction that guides the broader team.

Product Manager – AI-Native Strategy Execution

Location - Bangalore

About GravityONE

**GravityONE** is an AI-native technology company building the next generation of products for strategy, decision-making and execution. We work at the intersection of **AI, strategy, data and enterprise workflows**, helping organisations move beyond traditional dashboards and disconnected tools towards intelligent systems that can help leaders and teams plan, decide, coordinate and act.

Our products are designed for complex environments where strategy needs to translate into measurable outcomes—with the right context, governance, intelligence and accountability built into the way organisations operate.

One of our core products, **StrategyDotZero**, is building an AI-native strategy-execution platform for governments and enterprises. We help executives, Strategy Offices, PMOs and transformation teams connect strategy, planning, performance, portfolios and delivery into one intelligence-enabled operating environment.

Our ambition is to move beyond dashboards and workflow tools—to create governed digital experts and agentic workflows that help organisations plan, decide, coordinate and act with greater confidence.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional, hands-on **Product Manager** to turn this vision into a focused, market-ready product.

You will sit at the intersection of **strategy, design, data, analytics and AI**: shaping product direction, rapidly testing concepts with customers, and working closely with engineering, AI and growth teams to turn complex problems into elegant, adoptable capabilities.

This is a build-stage role for someone who enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly and can balance bold product thinking with disciplined execution. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring the **structured problem-solving and transformation mindset of top-tier consulting**, combined with strong product judgement and the ability to build and ship.

What you will do

* Translate the StrategyDotZero vision into clear product strategy, customer journeys, MVPs, roadmaps and fortnightly release plans.
* Shape AI-native experiences across strategy, planning, portfolio management, PMO, performance, benefits, risk and executive decision support.
* Define how agentic workflows, LLM-enabled generation, analytics, enterprise data and human approval work together in practical product experiences.
* Rapidly create wireframes, clickable prototypes, concept demonstrations and lightweight proof-of-value solutions to test ideas with users before building at scale.
* Lead product discovery with executives, PMO leaders, strategy teams and delivery practitioners; identify high-value problems, validate assumptions and translate insight into product decisions.
* Write high-quality user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, workflow logic and release documentation that engineering teams can build with confidence.
* Work closely with engineers and AI specialists to define fit-for-purpose agent behaviours, inputs, outputs, controls, evaluation criteria and user feedback loops.
* Ensure every capability is enterprise-ready: role-based access, source evidence, data quality, confidence indicators, auditability and human approval for material decisions or changes.
* Prioritise the roadmap using customer value, strategic differentiation, delivery effort, technical dependencies and commercial potential.
* Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, release readiness and post-release learning with discipline and pace.
* Partner with growth and customer teams to shape demos, value narratives, pilots, customer feedback loops and product-market fit.

What we are looking for

* **5+ years of experience** in product management, product design, strategy/technology consulting or a related product-building role.
* **MBA from a reputed institution**, preferably with a focus on strategy, technology, operations or a related discipline.
* **Prior experience with a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) or a strong strategy/management consulting environment is highly preferred.** We value candidates who have developed strong structured problem-solving, executive communication, business transformation and stakeholder management skills and can apply that thinking to product development.
* Experience building **B2B, enterprise SaaS, workflow, analytics, data or AI-enabled products**—ideally in complex, regulated or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong understanding of strategy execution, planning, PMO, portfolio management, transformation, performance or operational governance; deep expertise in every domain is not required, but curiosity and rapid learning are.
* Practical familiarity with AI product patterns: **LLMs, RAG, structured outputs, agentic workflows, enterprise data context, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation and feedback loops.**
* Strong UX and design judgement, with the ability to use tools such as **Figma and AI-assisted prototyping tools** to make concepts tangible quickly.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards, integrations, APIs and enterprise workflow concepts; able to speak credibly with engineers without needing to be a full-time developer.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move comfortably between a **client executive, product designer, engineer and delivery practitioner.**
* A strong bias toward action: able to frame a problem, form a hypothesis, prototype, test, learn and improve within days—not months.
* Comfortable in a lean, high-growth environment where ownership is broad, priorities evolve and quality still matters.

What success looks like

* A focused, differentiated product roadmap that converts the StrategyDotZero vision into commercially valuable releases.
* Fast, evidence-led product discovery with customers and a regular cadence of validated prototypes and shipped capabilities.

This is deliberately a technical Product Owner role. We are not looking for a pure business analyst or a scrum administrator. We want someone who can sit with engineers, read the design, challenge an estimate on its merits, and still hold a credible conversation with stakeholders about value and priority.

* Software development life cycle: a solid, practical understanding of the full SDLC requirements, design,

development, testing, release and maintenance and how decisions early in the cycle play out later

familiarity

months

* 2 to 3 years in product or growth, with a track record of experiments that moved core funnel metrics in B2C or B2B2C settings.

description:
Job Description

**Company:** Upstox

**Location:** Mumbai

**Work arrangement:** 5 days in the office

**Experience:** 3–7 years

**About Upstox**

Upstox is building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and accessible to everyone. As one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, Upstox is backed by leading global investors, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global. Our mission is to enable wealth creation for every Indian, serving millions of users ranging from first-time investors to experienced traders. We operate at speed, with purpose, and in an environment that values impact, ownership, and innovation.

  

**The Role: Growth Product Manager – F&O**

Futures & Options is one of the most active trading segments at Upstox, and this role sits right where F&O trader behavior meets business outcomes. As Growth Product Manager – F&O, you'll drive business growth and customer engagement across the F&O product, owning initiatives focused on activation, reactivation, revenue and ARPAU improvement.

You'll work closely with the Product Manager and business stakeholders to spot growth opportunities and translate business problems into clear, well-structured requirements. Your core ownership is business requirements, growth opportunities, F&O metrics, funnel optimization and business impact — documented through BRDs rather than PRDs. Your interaction with Design and Engineering will be relatively limited and largely routed through the Product Manager, with Business, Analytics/Data and other cross-functional teams as your day-to-day partners.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**F&O Growth & Business Metrics**

* Drive initiatives that improve key F&O growth metrics — activations, reactivations, engagement and ARPAU
* Identify opportunities across the customer journey that can positively impact revenue and business performance
* Analyze business and customer data to uncover growth opportunities, funnel gaps and areas of improvement
* Work with relevant stakeholders to define success metrics and measure business impact

**Business Requirements & Product Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to identify and prioritize business opportunities
* Translate business problems, customer insights and growth opportunities into detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Clearly articulate the business objective, customer problem, requirements, use cases, expected outcomes and success metrics
* Work with the Product Manager to ensure business requirements translate effectively into product initiatives
* Participate in discussions around feature prioritization and business impact

**New Product & Feature Initiatives**

* Identify and propose new features or enhancements based on customer needs, market opportunities and business objectives
* Develop BRDs for new initiatives and work with the Product Manager through the product development lifecycle
* Support feature launches by defining business objectives, target users, adoption metrics and go-to-market requirements
* Track post-launch performance and recommend improvements to drive adoption and business impact

**Funnel & Growth Optimization**

* Analyze existing F&O customer funnels to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Drive initiatives to improve activation, reactivation, conversion, feature adoption and engagement
* Evaluate existing product features and customer journeys to find opportunities for optimization
* Use data and experimentation insights to recommend changes that improve business outcomes

**F&O Domain Expertise**

* Bring a strong understanding of Futures & Options trading and trader behavior
* Understand key F&O customer journeys, use cases and pain points
* Monitor market and industry trends to identify relevant growth and product opportunities
* Translate F&O business and customer needs into actionable product requirements

**How Success Is Measured**

This role is closely tied to measurable business outcomes: F&O activation, reactivation, ARPAU, revenue impact, funnel conversion, feature adoption, customer engagement and the performance of the growth initiatives you drive.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Experience:** 3–7 years in Product Management, Growth, Business/Product Strategy, Fintech or a similar role
* **F&O exposure:** Hands-on experience with, or strong exposure to, F&O trading products
* **Commercial sense:** A strong understanding of business metrics, revenue levers and growth metrics
* **Growth track record:** Experience working on initiatives involving activation, reactivation, ARPAU, conversion or revenue improvement
* **BRD craft:** Experience creating Business Requirement Documents and translating business problems into clear requirements
* **Product partnership:** Understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience working closely with Product Managers
* **Analytical rigour:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities through data
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across Business, Product and Analytics
* **Ownership:** The ability to work independently and drive business initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You'll own growth for F&O, one of the most active and revenue-critical segments on one of India's fastest-growing trading platforms.
* Your work is tied directly to outcomes that matter — activation, reactivation, ARPAU and revenue - so your impact is visible and measurable.
* You'll shape what gets built, turning trader insight and data into BRDs that become real product initiatives.
* You'll work alongside sharp Product, Business and Analytics teams who move fast and care about doing it right.
* Every initiative you drive will shape how millions of Indian traders experience the markets.

description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

**The role**

We have more ideas than we can build. Your job is to figure out which ones are real, and turn the survivors into a product specification sharp enough for engineering to build from.

You won't be generating ideas!! You'll be the person who decides which ones deserve investment — through live customer conversations, rigorous market sizing, and a written case that leadership can act on. Some of what you look at should die. Killing an idea well is as valuable here as championing one !!

**What you'll do**

* Take a rough concept and design the fastest honest test of whether there's a real need behind it
* Run customer and prospect interviews; separate what people said from what you concluded
* Size the opportunity — TAM/SAM, pricing, unit economics — and be clear about which assumptions the number actually rests on
* Write the recommendation memo: build, don't build, or build something narrower. Own the call.
* Turn a validated concept into a PRD — problem, scope, what's in the first version and what isn't
* Work with engineering leads on feasibility early enough that it changes the spec, not after

**What we're looking for**

* MBA from IIM A/B/C/L/I/K or equivalent.
* Exceptional structured writing. Your memos are the product of this role.
* High Comfort with numbers: financial modeling in Excel/Sheets, basic SQL, product analytics
* Can hold a real conversation with a senior Global executive based in developed markets (or a frustrated customer without a script !!)
* Already using AI tools in how you work, not just aware of them

**What you get**

Direct access to CXOs on a daily basis, real ownership of investment recommendations, and a short path between your analysis and what actually gets built.

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

### **Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model:**

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

* **Hub -** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
* **Hybrid -** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote - 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
* Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

**Execution & Team Leadership**

* Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
* Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
* Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

**Mobile & Distribution**

* Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
* Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
* Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

**Mandatory:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
* Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
* Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
* Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
* Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
* Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
* A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
* You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

* Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.
* Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.
* Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.
* A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.
* Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).
* A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.
* An engineering background or computer science degree.
* Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

**Why this role:**

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**
